about: Ask in words' held-out set 2 (the operator, 2026-10-25, C1724: held-out set 1 was seen when v6 was measured and is retired as a test; this set replaces it). Written before prompt v7 was measured, and never seen while tuning: no prompt may be changed to fit these questions. No lab device is new to both sets (the network's twelve are all named by the 20 or by set 1), so it asks about r6, s2 and s5, the three the 20 never name, with metrics neither the 20 nor set 1 expects and no prompt names, in phrasings of its own, among them the named spans C1740's ruling defines (yesterday, this week, last week). Two ambiguous cases expect a question back (Mercury's own guidance counts as one, by the operator's scoring ruling); one asks for something no metric holds; one healthy-nothing case (flaps on r6 in the last hour) expects an answer whose query finds nothing wrong. Each expectation was read from the live catalogue on 2026-10-25 (what r6, s2 and s5 carry) and is checked by the stale-expectation check before every measurement. Measured beside the 20, five runs each, and reported apart; its consistency is the score that counts for C1724.
